content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on sales invoice:new, the pointer rests on an unlabeled anchor at about x=125, y=100 (events 1:0, 278:267, 598:578), and the screen then changes to customer:list (events 274, 277, 280, 283), which fits the Customer (list) round-trip in the insight.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, make the anchor at about x=125, y=100 (its label is not in the events) open customer:list in a new tab, or stop it navigating in the same tab, so the Sales Invoice form stays mounted and the user does not have to return to it.", "cited_event_ids": ["1:0", "278:267", "598:578", "274", "277", "280", "283"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The anchor's label and navigation target are not in the events", "No click event on the anchor appears, so its link to the customer:list navigation is inferred from pointer position and timing", "Why users returned to sales invoice:new is not in the events", "The app:* navigation events at t_ms 0 are ambiguous and were not used", "The 2 s to 4 s time lost per user is not explained by the events"]}
